dashboard.label: Better Map - RBA Risk Heatmap
dashboard.description: v1.6 showcase: risk-based-alerting heatmap that aggregates accumulated risk scores per geographic bin (lat/lon rounded to two decimals). The RBA module emits an SPL helper macro you can use against the Splunk ES risk index. Replace the inline SPL with: index=risk | bin lat span=0.5 | bin lon span=0.5 | stats sum(risk_score) AS risk by lat, lon.
